_comment: N-400's monthly spend ceiling, and the copy shown when it is reached.
The SHAPE of this gate is declared in config/apps.yml (flat, one cap for
every caller, because no per-call entitlement of N-400's reaches GP).
The NUMBER lives here so it is a dashboard dial rather than a deploy.
⚠ Per config/remote/OWNERSHIP.md, ADDING this file propagates on boot but
CHANGING the number below does not. To move the cap in production, push it
through PUT /webhooks/admin/config/n400/budget and verify against prod.
Editing this file alone does nothing to a running server.
UNCAPPED (-1) on 2026-09-08. Scott: no budget limits on development
teams, and no production user can reach the N-400 lane. -1 is the
The apps.yml floor is -1 too, so a failed read cannot silently
re-impose $5 and halt the dev lane. That INVERTS the old note here
about absent config never meaning unlimited: that rule guards against
an ACCIDENTAL uncap, and here unlimited is the intent.
SAFE ONLY WHILE no real user can reach this app, which is true for one
reason: com.weirtech.n400helper is absent from CZ_APPLE_BUNDLE_ID. Add
that bundle id and leave this at -1 and every real user has unlimited
spend with no ceiling anywhere. Decide the two together.
